entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi Isaac. I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet a while ago, and I'm just so confused by the website. I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do.
I can certainly help you look into that. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference, I suppose. It's the color. It looked different online, and now I'm worried it's not right. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I've just been feeling overwhelmed by it all. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help. It's very important that you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety. Let me just pull up your order information. ... Okay, I see here that the helmet was delivered 79 days ago.
Oh, is that a problem? The policy page was so confusing, I wasn't sure if that was too long.
Not a problem at all. For a standard item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 90 days. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can approve this return for you right now.
You can? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried I had made a mistake and was stuck with it.

You're very welcome. I've just processed the return authorization. I am sending an email to you as we speak with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. All you need to do is print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Okay, an email with a label. I think I can handle that. Thank you for making it so simple for me.

It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help. Thank you!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
